name: payload-collection-convention
description: Manages Payload CMS collections with a standardized naming convention and directory structure.
instructions: Always organize Payload collections in the src/collections/ directory with directories (no flat files).
Name all collection exports using <collectionSlug>Collection format: userCollection, mediaCollection, postCollection.
Use pattern: <slug>/<collection-file>.collection.ts where the collection file is named <slug>.collection.ts.
Create an index.ts file at src/collections/index.ts that exports all collections individually.
In payload.config.ts, import individual collections from './collections' and create a local collections array.
1. Create a directory named after the collection slug (e.g., users/)
4. Update src/collections/index.ts to export the new collection individually
5. payload.config.ts will import from './collections' and create a local array
This ensures a clean, organized structure without mixed naming conventions.
Avoid: flat-file collections (Users.ts), or PASCASE naming (Users, Media)
